## Intent

State the one thing this record is for, in a sentence a reader can act on. A third-party work, "Some Title" (2025), covers this in chapter 1, which is a framing the clean-room rule refuses.

## Context & Forces

The forces that pull against each other, named so that a reader can weigh them.

The parts, and how they are wired together.

What it costs, and what it buys.
